title: TWC probability-policy conflict corrected: one regenerated feed, no fan-vote blend
detail: The former hand-authored TWC 67%/72% probabilities, fan polls, outright triangulation and unsupported health/bracket/roster-causality claims are withdrawn. /twc-picks/ now copies this deployment’s audited complete-picks data and displays both source probabilities, default picks, quote times and gaps. The older e6c0f47d warning is retained as a historical audit finding; it no longer describes the regenerated page. The old file-copy step that could overwrite the generated page was removed and regression-tested.

title: Withdrawn interpretation: in-play price called prematch, symmetric rest, and causal onboarding discount
detail: The Aurora–NiP 98.65% historical provider observation was in-play, not prematch; a single series cannot establish forecast calibration. Playing on the same date does not establish equal rest hours. The Aurora rebuild report is dated 8 July, not a verified new October change or a proven cause of the 9z loss. These unsupported interpretations are removed from the dated previews; original market observation times remain unchanged. Day-3 starts are verified from HLTV epoch attributes at 14:00/17:00 UTC. The current page makes no rest, illness or onboarding probability adjustment.
